formatDescription: The Visualization Toolkit Unstructured Grid Format is and xml based legacy format associated with the Visualization Toolkit. The format is used to store spatial and attribute data. .vtu files contain both the geometric structure (points and cells) and the associated data values (e.g., temperature, pressure, or velocity) for a single time step.
provenanceCompoundName: Digital Research Alliance of Canada - FRDR / Alliance de recherche numérique du Canada – DFDR
